name: Gate Market
description: A walled yard in the ash, where the last traders before the throne keep their stock.
rumors: The lord has been hiring sellswords. War is coming, mark my words.
Beyond the eastern gate lies the scorched lands. Only the desperate go there.
Steel weapons from the castle forge are the finest you'll find this side of the mountains.
There's talk of an ancient dungeon beneath the Stone Ruins. Treasure for the bold.
